gql: MATCH (it:InterestTag {category: 'Sports'})<-[:INTERESTED_IN]-(u:User)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)-[:RECORDED_AS]->(ee:EngagementEvent) RETURN it.tagName, AVG(ee.sentiment) AS avgSentiment, COUNT(ee) AS eventCount ORDER BY avgSentiment DESC

question: List the content items that are similar to at least two other content items and have been engaged with by users who are members of communities with an activity level above 0.5. Return the content item ID, type, and the count of such qualifying communities.
gql: MATCH (ci:ContentItem)-[:SIMILAR_TO]->(similar:ContentItem) RETURN ci, COUNT(similar) AS similarityCount NEXT FILTER similarityCount >= 2 MATCH (ci)<-[:ENGAGED_WITH]-(u:User)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(c:Community) WHERE c.activityLevel > 0.5 RETURN ci, COUNT(DISTINCT c) AS qualifyingCommunities NEXT FILTER qualifyingCommunities > 0 RETURN ci.ContentItem_id, ci.type, qualifyingCommunities

question: Identify users who have engaged with content items of type 'video' more than 5 times. For these users, return their username, the count of video engagements, and the average duration of these engagement events.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[e:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem{type:'video'})-[:RECORDED_AS]->(ee:EngagementEvent) RETURN u, COUNT(e) AS engagementCount, AVG(ee.`duration`) AS avgDuration NEXT FILTER engagementCount > 5 RETURN u.username, engagementCount, avgDuration

question: List all interest tags that are associated with users who have joined communities with an activity level greater than 0.8. Return the tag name, category, and the count of distinct users associated with each tag.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag), (u)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(c:Community) WHERE c.activityLevel > 0.8 RETURN it.tagName, it.category, COUNT(DISTINCT u) AS userCount

question: Retrieve content items that were created by verified creators and have been engaged with by users who have privacy settings set to 'public'. Also, return the content item ID, type, and the number of public users who engaged with it.
gql: MATCH (cr:Creator {verificationStatus: true})-[:CREATED]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:ENGAGED_WITH]-(u:User {privacySettings: 'public'}) RETURN ci.ContentItem_id, ci.type, COUNT(u) AS publicUserEngagements

question: List all users who are members of communities with an activity level greater than 0.5 and have shown interest in at least five different interest tags. Return the user ID, username, and the count of distinct interest tags.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(c:Community) WHERE c.activityLevel > 0.5 RETURN u NEXT MATCH (u)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag) RETURN u, COUNT(DISTINCT it) AS interestCount NEXT FILTER interestCount >= 5 RETURN u.User_id, u.username, interestCount

question: Find content items that have been engaged with by users who have an interest strength greater than 0.8 in at least three different interest tags. Return the content item ID, type, and the count of such users.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[i:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag) WHERE i.interestStrength > 0.8 RETURN u, COUNT(it) AS strongInterests NEXT FILTER strongInterests >= 3 MATCH (u)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem) RETURN ci.ContentItem_id, ci.type, COUNT(DISTINCT u) AS userCount

question: Retrieve the names and descriptions of communities that have members who have engaged with content items created by unverified creators. Ensure no duplicate communities are returned.
gql: MATCH (c:Community)<-[:MEMBER_OF]-(u:User)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:CREATED]-(cr:Creator {verificationStatus: false}) RETURN DISTINCT c.name, c.description

question: Retrieve the usernames of users who have engaged with content items similar to those they have previously engaged with, ensuring the similarity score is greater than 0.8, and include the engagement timestamps.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci1:ContentItem)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(ci2:ContentItem)<-[:ENGAGED_WITH]-(u) WHERE s.similarityScore > 0.8 RETURN DISTINCT u.username, ci1.creationDate, ci2.creationDate

question: Find users who have engaged with content items similar to those created by verified creators. Return the usernames of these users and the engagement types, ensuring no duplicate records.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci1:ContentItem)-[:SIMILAR_TO]->(ci2:ContentItem)<-[:CREATED]-(c:Creator {verificationStatus: true}) RETURN DISTINCT u.username, ci1.type AS engagementType

question: Retrieve the names and descriptions of communities where members have an average activity score greater than 0.5 and the community's member count exceeds 100. Order the results by member count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[m:MEMBER_OF]->(c:Community) RETURN c, AVG(m.activityScore) AS avgActivityScore NEXT FILTER avgActivityScore > 0.5 AND c.memberCount > 100 RETURN c.name, c.description, c.memberCount ORDER BY c.memberCount DESC

question: List the interest tags associated with users who have been recommended content items by engines using the 'collaborative_filtering' algorithm. Include the tag names and categories, avoiding duplicates.
gql: MATCH (re:RecommendationEngine {algorithmType: 'collaborative_filtering'})-[:GENERATED_BY]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:ENGAGED_WITH]-(u:User)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag) RETURN DISTINCT it.tagName, it.category

question: Identify users who are interested in at least three different categories of interest tags and have engaged with content items from at least five different creators. Return the user ID, username, and the count of distinct categories and creators.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag) RETURN u, COUNT(DISTINCT it.category) AS categoryCount NEXT FILTER categoryCount >= 3 MATCH (u)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:CREATED]-(c:Creator) RETURN u, categoryCount, COUNT(DISTINCT c) AS creatorCount NEXT FILTER creatorCount >= 5 RETURN u.User_id, u.username, categoryCount, creatorCount

question: List all recommendation engines that have generated recommendations for users with an interest strength greater than 0.7 in 'Sports' category interest tags. Include the engine ID, algorithm type, and version.
gql: MATCH (re:RecommendationEngine)-[:GENERATED_BY]->(u:User)-[i:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag {category: 'Sports'}) WHERE i.interestStrength > 0.7 RETURN DISTINCT re.RecommendationEngine_id, re.algorithmType, re.version

question: List all recommendation engines that have generated recommendations for users who have recorded engagement events with a duration longer than 120 seconds. Return the engine's algorithm type and the count of such users.
gql: MATCH (re:RecommendationEngine)-[:GENERATED_BY]->(u:User)-[:RECORDED_AS]->(ee:EngagementEvent) WHERE ee.`duration` > 120 RETURN re.algorithmType, COUNT(DISTINCT u) AS userCount

question: Find the average sentiment score of engagement events recorded by users who are members of communities with an activity level above 0.7 and have been interested in at least 3 interest tags. Return the average sentiment score.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(c:Community) WHERE c.activityLevel > 0.7 RETURN u NEXT MATCH (u)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag) RETURN u, COUNT(it) AS interestTagCount NEXT FILTER interestTagCount >= 3 MATCH (u)-[:RECORDED_AS]->(ee:EngagementEvent) RETURN AVG(ee.sentiment) AS averageSentiment

question: Determine the interest tags that are associated with users who have engaged with content items having a sentiment score below -0.5. Return the tag name, category, and the count of such negative engagements per tag.
gql: MATCH (ee:EngagementEvent)<-[:RECORDED_AS]-(ci:ContentItem)<-[:ENGAGED_WITH]-(u:User)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag) WHERE ee.sentiment < -0.5 RETURN it.tagName, it.category, COUNT(ee) AS negativeEngagementCount

question: Find all users who have engaged with content items created by verified creators and are also members of communities with an activity level greater than 0.5. Return the user IDs and usernames.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:CREATED]-(cr:Creator {verificationStatus: true}), (u:User)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(c:Community) WHERE c.activityLevel > 0.5 RETURN DISTINCT u.User_id, u.username

question: Retrieve the recommendation engines that have generated recommendations for content items which are similar to other content items with a confidence level above 0.9. Return the engine IDs and the count of such content items.
gql: MATCH (re:RecommendationEngine)-[:GENERATED_BY]->(ci:ContentItem)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(ci2:ContentItem) WHERE s.confidenceLevel > 0.9 RETURN re, COUNT(ci) AS contentItemCount NEXT RETURN re.RecommendationEngine_id, contentItemCount

question: Retrieve the usernames of users who have engaged with content items generated by at least three different recommendation engines using the 'content_based' algorithm, and whose privacy settings indicate they are 'public'.
gql: MATCH (u:User{privacySettings:'public'})-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:GENERATED_BY]-(re:RecommendationEngine{algorithmType:'content_based'}) RETURN u, COUNT(DISTINCT re) AS engineCount NEXT FILTER engineCount >= 3 RETURN u.username

question: Find the top 3 creators with the highest average content quality scores who have created at least 5 content items. Return their display names and average content quality scores.
gql: MATCH (cr:Creator)-[:CREATED]->(ci:ContentItem) RETURN cr, AVG(ci.engagementMetrics) AS avgQualityScore, COUNT(ci) AS contentItemCount NEXT FILTER contentItemCount >= 5 RETURN cr.displayName, avgQualityScore ORDER BY avgQualityScore DESC LIMIT 3

question: Identify users who are interested in at least three interest tags related to 'Technology' and have engaged with content items of type 'video'. Return the user IDs and the count of such engagements.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag{category:'Technology'}), (u)-[e:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem{type:'video'}) RETURN u, COUNT(DISTINCT it) AS techInterestCount, COUNT(e) AS videoEngagementCount NEXT FILTER techInterestCount >= 3 RETURN u.User_id, videoEngagementCount

question: Identify users who are members of at least two communities and have interests in tags with a popularity score greater than 8.0. Return their user ID and the count of such interest tags.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(c:Community) RETURN u, COUNT(c) AS communityCount NEXT FILTER communityCount >= 2 MATCH (u)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag) WHERE it.popularityScore > 8.0 RETURN u, COUNT(it) AS highPopularityInterests NEXT FILTER highPopularityInterests > 0 RETURN u.User_id, highPopularityInterests

question: Retrieve all creators who have created content that has been recommended by at least two different recommendation engines, and return their creator ID, display name, and the number of distinct recommendation engines.
gql: MATCH (cr:Creator)-[:CREATED]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:GENERATED_BY]-(re:RecommendationEngine) RETURN cr, COUNT(DISTINCT re) AS engineCount NEXT FILTER engineCount >= 2 RETURN cr.Creator_id, cr.displayName, engineCount

question: Identify the top 5 most popular interest tags (by popularity score) that are linked to users who have engaged with content items created by unverified creators. Return the tag name and its popularity score.
gql: MATCH (it:InterestTag)<-[:INTERESTED_IN]-(u:User)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:CREATED]-(cr:Creator) WHERE cr.verificationStatus = false RETURN it ORDER BY it.popularityScore DESC NEXT RETURN it.tagName, it.popularityScore LIMIT 5

question: List all verified creators who have generated content that has a similarity score higher than 0.8 with at least two other content items. Include the creator's display name and the count of such highly similar content items.
gql: MATCH (cr:Creator{verificationStatus:true})-[:CREATED]->(ci:ContentItem)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(:ContentItem) WHERE s.similarityScore > 0.8 RETURN cr, ci, COUNT(s) AS highSimilarityCount NEXT FILTER highSimilarityCount >= 2 RETURN cr.displayName, COUNT(ci) AS highlySimilarContentCount

question: Which users have shown interest in at least five different tags and are members of more than two communities? Provide the user ID and the total number of tags and communities they are associated with.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag), (u)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(c:Community) RETURN u, COUNT(DISTINCT it) AS tagCount, COUNT(DISTINCT c) AS communityCount NEXT FILTER tagCount >= 5 AND communityCount > 2 RETURN u.User_id, tagCount, communityCount

question: Retrieve the top 5 most popular interest tags based on their popularity score, along with the total number of users interested in each tag and the average interest strength. Only include tags where the average interest strength is greater than 0.7.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[i:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag) RETURN it.tagName, COUNT(u) AS userCount, AVG(i.interestStrength) AS avgInterestStrength ORDER BY it.popularityScore DESC LIMIT 5

question: Discover users who are interested in at least five interest tags and have never engaged with content similar to what they usually engage with. Return the user ID and the count of their interest tags.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag) RETURN u, COUNT(it) AS interestCount NEXT FILTER interestCount >= 5 MATCH (u)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci1:ContentItem)-[:SIMILAR_TO]->(ci2:ContentItem) RETURN u, interestCount, COUNT(ci2) AS similarEngagements NEXT FILTER similarEngagements = 0 RETURN u.User_id, interestCount

question: Find users who are members of communities with an activity level above 0.75 and have engaged with content items of type 'video'. Return the usernames of these users along with the names of the communities they are active in, ensuring no duplicates.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(c:Community) WHERE c.activityLevel > 0.75 RETURN u, c NEXT MATCH (u)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem) WHERE ci.type = 'video' RETURN DISTINCT u.username, c.name

question: Determine for each verified creator, the sum of engagement durations from all engagement events related to their content items, excluding any engagements with a sentiment value below 0.5. Present the creator’s display name and the calculated total duration.
gql: MATCH (cr:Creator{verificationStatus:true})-[:CREATED]->(ci:ContentItem)-[:RECORDED_AS]->(ee:EngagementEvent) WHERE ee.sentiment >= 0.5 RETURN cr.displayName, SUM(ee.`duration`) AS totalDuration

question: Identify content items that are similar to at least three other content items with a similarity score greater than 0.8. For these content items, return their IDs, creation dates, and the average similarity score of their related content items.
gql: MATCH (ci:ContentItem)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(:ContentItem) WHERE s.similarityScore > 0.8 RETURN ci, COUNT(s) AS similarItemCount, AVG(s.similarityScore) AS avgSimilarity NEXT FILTER similarItemCount >= 3 RETURN ci.ContentItem_id, ci.creationDate, avgSimilarity

question: Find communities where members have engaged with content items that are similar to at least two other content items with a confidence level greater than 0.9. Return the community name, member count, and the average number of such engagements per member.
gql: MATCH (c:Community)<-[:MEMBER_OF]-(u:User)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(:ContentItem) WHERE s.confidenceLevel > 0.9 RETURN c, u, COUNT(s) AS similarEngagements NEXT FILTER similarEngagements >= 2 RETURN c.name, c.memberCount, AVG(similarEngagements) AS avgEngagementsPerMember

question: Find the users who have engaged with content items created by verified creators and are part of communities with member counts greater than 1000. Return the user ID, username, and the number of such engagements.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:CREATED]-(cr:Creator {verificationStatus: true}), (u)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(c:Community) WHERE c.memberCount > 1000 RETURN u.User_id, u.username, COUNT(ci) AS engagementCount

question: List the recommendation engines that have generated recommendations for users who are members of the top 5 most active communities (based on activity level). Return the engine ID and the count of distinct users recommended.
gql: MATCH (c:Community) RETURN c ORDER BY c.activityLevel DESC LIMIT 5 NEXT MATCH (re:RecommendationEngine)-[:GENERATED_BY]->(u:User)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(c) RETURN re.RecommendationEngine_id, COUNT(DISTINCT u) AS recommendedUsers

question: Retrieve the names of communities where members have engaged with content items having a sentiment score below 0.3, and also return the average duration of engagement events within those communities.
gql: MATCH (c:Community)<-[:MEMBER_OF]-(u:User)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)-[:RECORDED_AS]->(ee:EngagementEvent) WHERE ee.sentiment < 0.3 RETURN c, AVG(ee.`duration`) AS avgDuration NEXT RETURN c.name, avgDuration

question: For each verified creator, find the total number of collaborations they have participated in through content creation, and only include those with more than five collaborations. Return the creator's display name and collaboration count.
gql: MATCH (cr:Creator{verificationStatus:true})-[r:CREATED]->(ci:ContentItem) WHERE r.collaboration = true RETURN cr, COUNT(r) AS collaborationCount NEXT FILTER collaborationCount > 5 RETURN cr.displayName, collaborationCount

question: Retrieve content items that were generated by recommendation engines using the 'content_based' algorithm and have been engaged with by users interested in at least four different categories. Return the content item IDs and the number of distinct categories.
gql: MATCH (re:RecommendationEngine{algorithmType:'content_based'})-[:GENERATED_BY]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:ENGAGED_WITH]-(u:User)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag) RETURN ci, u, COUNT(DISTINCT it.category) AS categoryCount NEXT FILTER categoryCount >= 4 RETURN ci.ContentItem_id, categoryCount

question: Identify the top 10 creators with the highest content quality scores who have created content items that were engaged with by users interested in tags from the 'Technology' category. Return the creator's display name, content quality score, and the count of distinct users engaged.
gql: MATCH (cr:Creator)-[:CREATED]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:ENGAGED_WITH]-(u:User)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag{category:'Technology'}) RETURN cr, COUNT(DISTINCT u) AS userCount NEXT RETURN cr.displayName, cr.contentQualityScore, userCount ORDER BY cr.contentQualityScore DESC LIMIT 10

question: List all users who have engaged with content items created by verified creators only, and show their usernames along with the count of such engagements.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[e:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:CREATED]-(cr:Creator) WHERE cr.verificationStatus = true RETURN u, COUNT(e) AS engagementCount NEXT RETURN u.username, engagementCount

question: Find creators who have followers count greater than 1000 and have created content items that are similar to at least one other content item with a confidence level above 0.9. Return the creator's display name and follower count.
gql: MATCH (c:Creator)-[:CREATED]->(ci1:ContentItem)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(ci2:ContentItem) WHERE c.followerCount > 1000 AND s.confidenceLevel > 0.9 RETURN DISTINCT c.displayName, c.followerCount

question: Find the average popularity score of interest tags associated with content items created by verified creators who have a follower count greater than 50,000. Return the average popularity score and the category of those tags.
gql: MATCH (cr:Creator{verificationStatus:true}) WHERE cr.followerCount > 50000 RETURN cr NEXT MATCH (cr)-[:CREATED]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:ENGAGED_WITH]-(u:User)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag) RETURN AVG(it.popularityScore) AS avgPopularityScore, it.category

question: List the names of users who have engaged with content items created by unverified creators and have also shown interest in tags under the category 'Technology'. Include the user's username and the tag name, ensuring no duplicates.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:CREATED]-(cr:Creator {verificationStatus: false}), (u)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag {category: 'Technology'}) RETURN DISTINCT u.username, it.tagName

question: Find content items that have been engaged with by users who are members of at least three different communities. Include the content item ID, type, and the number of distinct communities these users belong to.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(c:Community), (u)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem) RETURN ci, u, COUNT(DISTINCT c) AS communityCount NEXT FILTER communityCount >= 3 RETURN ci.ContentItem_id, ci.type, communityCount

question: Find content items that are similar to others with a similarity score greater than 0.9 and have been recommended by engines using the 'collaborative_filtering' algorithm. Return the content item ID, type, and the count of such recommendations.
gql: MATCH (ci:ContentItem)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(:ContentItem) WHERE s.similarityScore > 0.9 RETURN DISTINCT ci NEXT MATCH (ci)<-[:GENERATED_BY]-(re:RecommendationEngine{algorithmType:'collaborative_filtering'}) RETURN ci.ContentItem_id, ci.type, COUNT(re) AS recommendationCount

question: List the top 5 interest tags based on the highest average engagement duration from users who have privacy settings as 'public'. Include the tag name and the average engagement duration.
gql: MATCH (u:User{privacySettings:'public'})-[i:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag) RETURN it.tagName AS tagName NEXT MATCH (u)-[e:ENGAGED_WITH]->(:ContentItem) RETURN tagName, AVG(e.`duration`) AS avgEngagementDuration ORDER BY avgEngagementDuration DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the interest tags that are associated with users who have engaged with content items of type 'video' more than 10 times. Include the tag name and the count of such engagements.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag), (u)-[ew:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem{type:'video'}) RETURN it, COUNT(ew) AS engagementCount NEXT FILTER engagementCount > 10 RETURN it.tagName, engagementCount

question: Find users who have engaged with content items created by verified creators and are interested in at least one interest tag from the 'Technology' category. Return their user IDs, usernames, and the count of distinct technology-related interest tags.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:CREATED]-(c:Creator{verificationStatus:true}) RETURN u NEXT MATCH (u)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag{category:'Technology'}) RETURN u, COUNT(DISTINCT it) AS techInterestCount NEXT FILTER techInterestCount >= 1 RETURN u.User_id, u.username, techInterestCount

question: Identify interest tags that are associated with users who have a privacy setting of 'public' and have engaged with content having an engagement metric score higher than 8.0. Return the tag names and the average popularity score of those tags.
gql: MATCH (u:User{privacySettings:'public'})-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag) RETURN it NEXT MATCH (u)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem) WHERE ci.engagementMetrics > '8.0' RETURN it.tagName, AVG(it.popularityScore) AS avgPopularityScore

question: Find the top 5 users with the highest average engagement duration across all content items they have engaged with. Return their username, registration date, and the average engagement duration.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[e:ENGAGED_WITH]->(:ContentItem) RETURN u.username, u.registrationDate, AVG(e.`duration`) AS avgDuration ORDER BY avgDuration DESC LIMIT 5

question: Identify users who have engaged with content from at least three different creators and are part of communities with an activity level above 0.75. Return the user IDs along with the number of distinct creators they've engaged with.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:CREATED]-(cr:Creator) RETURN u, COUNT(DISTINCT cr) AS creatorCount NEXT FILTER creatorCount >= 3 MATCH (u)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(c:Community) WHERE c.activityLevel > 0.75 RETURN u.User_id, creatorCount

question: List all communities whose members have shown interest in at least ten interest tags, and calculate the average popularity score of these tags per community. Order results by the highest average popularity score.
gql: MATCH (c:Community)<-[:MEMBER_OF]-(u:User)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag) RETURN c, u, COUNT(it) AS tagCount NEXT FILTER tagCount >= 10 MATCH (u)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it) RETURN c.name, AVG(it.popularityScore) AS avgPopularityScore ORDER BY avgPopularityScore DESC

question: Find users who are interested in at least three interest tags within the 'Technology' category and have engaged with content items created by verified creators. Return the user ID, username, and the count of such engagements.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag) WHERE it.category = 'Technology' RETURN u, COUNT(it) AS techInterests NEXT FILTER techInterests >= 3 MATCH (u)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:CREATED]-(cr:Creator) WHERE cr.verificationStatus = true RETURN u.User_id, u.username, COUNT(ci) AS engagementCount

question: Identify communities where the average activity score of members is above 0.6 and the community's member count exceeds 50. For these communities, return the community name, description, and the average activity score of members.
gql: MATCH (c:Community)<-[m:MEMBER_OF]-(u:User) RETURN c, AVG(m.activityScore) AS avgActivityScore NEXT FILTER avgActivityScore > 0.6 AND c.memberCount > 50 RETURN c.name, c.description, avgActivityScore

question: List all interest tags in the 'Science' category that are associated with users who have a privacy setting of 'public' and have engaged with content items having a similarity score greater than 0.95 to other content items. Return the tag names and the count of such highly similar engagements per tag.
gql: MATCH (it:InterestTag {category: 'Science'})<-[:INTERESTED_IN]-(u:User {privacySettings: 'public'})-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci1:ContentItem)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(ci2:ContentItem) WHERE s.similarityScore > 0.95 RETURN it.tagName, COUNT(*) AS highSimilarityEngagements

question: Retrieve users who have been recommended content items by at least two different recommendation engines and have engaged with all the recommended items. Include the user ID, username, and the count of distinct recommendation engines that recommended content to them.
gql: MATCH (u:User)<-[:GENERATED_BY]-(re:RecommendationEngine)-[:GENERATED_BY]->(ci:ContentItem) RETURN u, re, ci NEXT MATCH (u)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci) RETURN u, COUNT(DISTINCT re) AS engineCount NEXT FILTER engineCount >= 2 RETURN u.User_id, u.username, engineCount

question: Identify users who have engaged with content from at least 3 different verified creators and have shown interest in at least 2 interest tags from the 'Technology' category. Return their user IDs and the count of distinct verified creators they've engaged with.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:CREATED]-(cr:Creator{verificationStatus:true}) RETURN u, COUNT(DISTINCT cr) AS verifiedCreatorsCount NEXT FILTER verifiedCreatorsCount >= 3 MATCH (u)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag{category:'Technology'}) RETURN u, verifiedCreatorsCount, COUNT(DISTINCT it) AS techInterestsCount NEXT FILTER techInterestsCount >= 2 RETURN u.User_id, verifiedCreatorsCount

question: Determine the average activity level of communities grouped by the role users play within them, excluding roles marked as 'inactive'. Return the role and the average activity level.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[m:MEMBER_OF]->(c:Community) WHERE m.role <> 'inactive' RETURN m.role, AVG(c.activityLevel) AS averageActivityLevel ORDER BY averageActivityLevel DESC

question: Identify interest tags that are associated with users who have joined communities with an activity level greater than 0.8. Return the tag name and the number of such users, sorted by the number of users in descending order.
gql: MATCH (it:InterestTag)<-[:INTERESTED_IN]-(u:User)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(c:Community) WHERE c.activityLevel > 0.8 RETURN it, COUNT(u) AS userCount NEXT RETURN it.tagName, userCount ORDER BY userCount DESC

question: Find the top 5 creators with the highest average engagement duration across all their content items, considering only those creators whose content has received at least one engagement event with a positive sentiment. Return the creator's display name and their average engagement duration.
gql: MATCH (cr:Creator)-[:CREATED]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:ENGAGED_WITH]-(u:User)-[:RECORDED_AS]->(ee:EngagementEvent) WHERE ee.sentiment > 0 RETURN cr, AVG(ee.`duration`) AS avgDuration ORDER BY avgDuration DESC LIMIT 5 NEXT RETURN cr.displayName, avgDuration

question: Find the top 10 users with the highest total engagement duration across all content items they have engaged with, and return their usernames along with the total duration.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[e:ENGAGED_WITH]->(:ContentItem) RETURN u.username, SUM(e.`duration`) AS totalDuration ORDER BY totalDuration DESC LIMIT 10

question: List all creators who have created content items that have been engaged with by users interested in 'Technology' tags, and return the creator's display name and the count of such distinct content items.
gql: MATCH (c:Creator)-[:CREATED]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:ENGAGED_WITH]-(u:User)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag {category: 'Technology'}) RETURN c.displayName, COUNT(DISTINCT ci) AS contentItemCount

question: Identify communities where at least 3 members have engaged with content items similar to others with a confidence level above 0.9, and return the community name and the number of such qualifying members.
gql: MATCH (c:Community)<-[:MEMBER_OF]-(u:User)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(:ContentItem) WHERE s.confidenceLevel > 0.9 RETURN c, u, COUNT(ci) AS qualifiedEngagements NEXT FILTER qualifiedEngagements >= 3 RETURN c.name, COUNT(u) AS memberCount

question: Retrieve interest tags that are connected to users who are members of communities with a member count exceeding 5000, and return the tag name, category, and average interest strength of these tags among such users.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[i:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag), (u)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(c:Community) WHERE c.memberCount > 5000 RETURN it.tagName, it.category, AVG(i.interestStrength) AS avgInterestStrength

question: Find the recommendation engines that have generated recommendations for users interested in at least three different interest tags. Return the engine ID, algorithm type, and the count of distinct interest tags.
gql: MATCH (re:RecommendationEngine)-[:GENERATED_BY]->(u:User)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag) RETURN re, COUNT(DISTINCT it) AS distinctTags NEXT FILTER distinctTags >= 3 RETURN re.RecommendationEngine_id, re.algorithmType, distinctTags

question: Find users who are members of more than one community and have shown interest in at least three interest tags, returning their user ID, the number of communities they're part of, and the number of interest tags they're interested in.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(c:Community) RETURN u, COUNT(c) AS communityCount NEXT FILTER communityCount > 1 MATCH (u)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag) RETURN u, communityCount, COUNT(it) AS interestCount NEXT FILTER interestCount >= 3 RETURN u.User_id, communityCount, interestCount

question: List all users who have engaged with content items similar to those they are interested in, based on shared interest tags, and calculate the average confidence level of these similarity relationships. Only include users with an average confidence level above 0.8.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag)<-[:INTERESTED_IN]-(u2:User)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(ci2:ContentItem)<-[:ENGAGED_WITH]-(u) WHERE s.confidenceLevel > 0.8 RETURN u.username, AVG(s.confidenceLevel) AS avgConfidenceLevel

question: Calculate the average member count of communities where users who have interacted with content items tagged under the 'Science' category are members. Only consider communities with an activity level greater than 0.5.
gql: MATCH (it:InterestTag {category: 'Science'})<-[:INTERESTED_IN]-(u:User)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(c:Community) WHERE c.activityLevel > 0.5 RETURN AVG(c.memberCount) AS avgMemberCount

question: Find interest tags that are associated with users who have engaged with content items having a similarity score greater than 0.9. Return the tag name, category, and the count of distinct users associated with each tag through such engagements.
gql: MATCH (it:InterestTag)<-[:INTERESTED_IN]-(u:User)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(other:ContentItem) WHERE s.similarityScore > 0.9 RETURN it, COUNT(DISTINCT u) AS userCount NEXT RETURN it.tagName, it.category, userCount

question: Determine the communities with the highest activity levels where members have an average interest strength in 'Technology' tags greater than 0.7. Return the community name, description, and the average interest strength.
gql: MATCH (c:Community)<-[:MEMBER_OF]-(u:User)-[i:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag) WHERE it.category = 'Technology' RETURN c, AVG(i.interestStrength) AS avgInterestStrength NEXT FILTER avgInterestStrength > 0.7 RETURN c.name, c.description, avgInterestStrength ORDER BY c.activityLevel DESC

question: Which verified creators have followers exceeding 5000 and have authored content similar to other items with a similarity score above 0.9? Provide the creator’s display name and the count of such highly similar items.
gql: MATCH (cr:Creator {verificationStatus: true})-[:CREATED]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[s:SIMILAR_TO]-(similarCi:ContentItem) WHERE cr.followerCount > 5000 AND s.similarityScore > 0.9 RETURN cr.displayName, COUNT(similarCi) AS highSimilarityItemCount

question: Find the top 5 most active users who have engaged with content items created by verified creators and are also members of at least 3 communities. Return their usernames, the number of engagements, and the number of communities they belong to.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:CREATED]-(cr:Creator{verificationStatus:true}), (u)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(c:Community) RETURN u, COUNT(DISTINCT ci) AS engagementCount, COUNT(DISTINCT c) AS communityCount NEXT FILTER communityCount >= 3 RETURN u.username, engagementCount, communityCount ORDER BY engagementCount DESC LIMIT 5

question: Retrieve all content items that have received engagements from users interested in tags within the 'Technology' category, and were created by unverified creators. Return the content item ID, type, and the count of such engagements.
gql: MATCH (it:InterestTag {category: 'Technology'})<-[:INTERESTED_IN]-(u:User)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:CREATED]-(cr:Creator {verificationStatus: false}) RETURN ci.ContentItem_id, ci.type, COUNT(u) AS engagementCount

question: List the recommendation engines that generated recommendations for users who are part of communities with a member count greater than 1000. Return the engine ID, algorithm type, and the number of distinct users recommended.
gql: MATCH (re:RecommendationEngine)-[:GENERATED_BY]->(u:User)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(c:Community) WHERE c.memberCount > 1000 RETURN re.RecommendationEngine_id, re.algorithmType, COUNT(DISTINCT u) AS userCount

question: Find content items that were created by unverified creators but have been engaged with by users who are interested in at least five distinct interest tag categories. Return the content item IDs, their creation dates, and the count of distinct user categories interacting with them.
gql: MATCH (cr:Creator{verificationStatus:false})-[:CREATED]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:ENGAGED_WITH]-(u:User)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag) RETURN ci, cr, u, COUNT(DISTINCT it.category) AS userCategoryCount NEXT FILTER userCategoryCount >= 5 RETURN ci.ContentItem_id, ci.creationDate, COUNT(DISTINCT userCategoryCount) AS interactingUserCategories

question: Identify users who have shown interest in at least three distinct interest tags within the 'Technology' category and are members of communities with more than 1000 members. Return the usernames and the count of such qualifying communities.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag{category:'Technology'}) RETURN u, COUNT(DISTINCT it) AS techInterests NEXT FILTER techInterests >= 3 MATCH (u)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(c:Community) WHERE c.memberCount > 1000 RETURN u.username, COUNT(DISTINCT c) AS qualifyingCommunities

question: List the creators who have generated content collaboratively (as indicated by the collaboration flag) and have a follower count exceeding 10,000. For each such creator, also return the total number of collaborative content items they've created.
gql: MATCH (cr:Creator)-[cre:CREATED]->(ci:ContentItem) WHERE cre.collaboration = true AND cr.followerCount > 10000 RETURN cr.Creator_id, cr.displayName, COUNT(ci) AS collaborativeContentCount

question: Find the top 5 communities with the highest average sentiment scores from engagement events, considering only communities with more than 10 member engagements. Return the community name and average sentiment score.
gql: MATCH (c:Community)<-[:MEMBER_OF]-(u:User)-[:RECORDED_AS]->(ee:EngagementEvent) RETURN c, AVG(ee.sentiment) AS avgSentiment, COUNT(ee) AS engagementCount NEXT FILTER engagementCount > 10 RETURN c.name, avgSentiment ORDER BY avgSentiment DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the top 10 users who have engaged with content items from the most diverse set of creators (based on distinct creator IDs), and return their usernames along with the count of distinct creators.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:CREATED]-(cr:Creator) RETURN u, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.Creator_id) AS distinctCreators NEXT RETURN u.username, distinctCreators ORDER BY distinctCreators DESC LIMIT 10

question: Find interest tags that are associated with users who have been recommended content items by recommendation engines using the 'collaborative_filtering' algorithm, and return the tag name and the count of such associations.
gql: MATCH (it:InterestTag)<-[:INTERESTED_IN]-(u:User)<-[:GENERATED_BY]-(re:RecommendationEngine {algorithmType: 'collaborative_filtering'}) RETURN it.tagName, COUNT(*) AS associationCount

question: Find users who have shown interest (interest strength > 0.7) in at least four interest tags and have engaged with content items created by verified creators. Return the usernames of these users and the types of content they engaged with, ensuring no duplicates.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[i:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag) WHERE i.interestStrength > 0.7 RETURN u, COUNT(it) AS interests NEXT FILTER interests >= 4 MATCH (u)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:CREATED]-(c:Creator) WHERE c.verificationStatus = true RETURN DISTINCT u.username, ci.type

question: Find users who have engaged with content items that were created by verified creators and have also shown interest in tags related to 'Technology'. Return the user ID, username, and the count of such engagements.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:CREATED]-(c:Creator {verificationStatus: true}), (u)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag {category: 'Technology'}) RETURN u.User_id, u.username, COUNT(ci) AS engagementCount

question: Identify content items that are similar to others with a similarity score greater than 0.9 and were created by creators with a follower count exceeding 1000. Return the content item ID, type, and the average similarity score.
gql: MATCH (ci:ContentItem)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(:ContentItem)<-[:CREATED]-(c:Creator) WHERE s.similarityScore > 0.9 AND c.followerCount > 1000 RETURN ci.ContentItem_id, ci.type, AVG(s.similarityScore) AS avgSimilarityScore

question: List communities where members have interests in at least two different categories of interest tags and the community's member count exceeds 50. Return the community name, description, and the count of distinct interest categories among its members.
gql: MATCH (c:Community)<-[:MEMBER_OF]-(u:User)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag) WHERE c.memberCount > 50 RETURN c, COUNT(DISTINCT it.category) AS categoryCount NEXT FILTER categoryCount >= 2 RETURN c.name, c.description, categoryCount

question: Find users who are members of highly active communities (activity level > 0.8) and have engaged with content items that are similar to at least three other items with a confidence level over 0.75. Return the user ID, the number of such communities, and the total count of similar content engagements.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(c:Community) WHERE c.activityLevel > 0.8 RETURN u, COUNT(c) AS communityCount NEXT MATCH (u)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(:ContentItem) WHERE s.confidenceLevel > 0.75 RETURN u, communityCount, COUNT(s) AS similarEngagements NEXT FILTER similarEngagements >= 3 RETURN u.User_id, communityCount, similarEngagements

question: Identify users who are members of more than two communities and have engaged with content items created by verified creators. Return the user ID, username, and the count of distinct verified creators whose content they engaged with.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(c:Community) RETURN u, COUNT(c) AS communityCount NEXT FILTER communityCount > 2 MATCH (u)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:CREATED]-(cr:Creator{verificationStatus:true}) RETURN u.User_id, u.username, COUNT(DISTINCT cr) AS verifiedCreatorsCount

question: Identify content items that were created by unverified creators and have never been engaged with by any user. Return the content item IDs and their creation dates.

question: Retrieve a list of communities along with the number of verified creators who are members, where the community's member count exceeds 500. Order the results by the number of verified creators in descending order.

question: Retrieve the communities with the highest average sentiment scores from engagement events of their members’ content interactions, considering only communities with over 50 members. Return the community name and the average sentiment score.

question: Discover the recommendation engines that have suggested content items which subsequently received engagement events with a sentiment higher than 0.75. For each engine, return its ID, algorithm type, and the average sentiment of engagements on its recommended items.
gql: MATCH (re:RecommendationEngine)-[:GENERATED_BY]->(ci:ContentItem)-[:RECORDED_AS]->(ee:EngagementEvent) WHERE ee.sentiment > 0.75 RETURN re.RecommendationEngine_id, re.algorithmType, AVG(ee.sentiment) AS avgHighSentiment

question: List all users who have engaged with content from at least five different creators and have interests in tags from at least three different categories. Return the user ID, username, and the count of distinct creators and categories associated with the user.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:CREATED]-(c:Creator) RETURN u, COUNT(DISTINCT c) AS creatorCount NEXT FILTER creatorCount >= 5 MATCH (u)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag) RETURN u, creatorCount, COUNT(DISTINCT it.category) AS categoryCount NEXT FILTER categoryCount >= 3 RETURN u.User_id AS userId, u.username AS username, creatorCount, categoryCount

question: Determine the recommendation engines that have generated recommendations for users who engaged with content items having a similarity score above 0.9. Return the engine ID, algorithm type, and the count of such unique engagements.

question: Find the top 10 creators with the highest content quality scores who have created content items that are similar to at least three other content items. Return the creator's display name, content quality score, and the count of similar content relationships.

question: Retrieve the names and descriptions of communities where members have an average engagement duration greater than 120 seconds across all engagement events. Also, include the average sentiment of these engagement events.

question: Determine the recommendation engines that generated recommendations for users interested in 'Sports' category interest tags. For each engine, return its ID, algorithm type, and the count of distinct users it recommended to.

question: Retrieve the names of communities and the number of unique interest tags associated with their members, sorted by the number of tags in descending order.

question: Identify creators who have produced content items that have been engaged with by users interested in at least three different interest tags within the 'Technology' category. Return the creator's display name and the count of such distinct interest tags.

question: Identify creators who have produced content that has been engaged with by users interested in at least five different interest tag categories, and return the creator's display name along with the total number of such distinct user engagements.

question: Identify the top 10 most popular interest tags based on the number of users interested in them, considering only users who have engaged with at least 3 content items. Return the tag name, category, popularity score, and the count of interested users.

question: List all creators who have created content items that have been engaged with by users from communities with more than 100 members. Return distinct creator display names and their follower counts.

question: Retrieve the names of communities and their average member activity scores for users who have interacted with content having a similarity score greater than 0.8. Order the results by average activity score in descending order.

question: Which recommendation engines have generated recommendations for content items that were created by verified creators? Return the engine ID, algorithm type, and the count of such content items.

question: For each interest tag in the 'Technology' category, find the content items that are most similar to other content items with a similarity score higher than 0.85. Return the tag name, content item ID, and the maximum similarity score found for each tag.

question: Identify the top 5 most popular interest tags among users who have engaged with content items created by verified creators. Return the tag name, category, and popularity score, sorted by popularity score in descending order.

question: Retrieve the names and follower counts of creators who have created content items that are similar to at least three other content items with a similarity score greater than 0.9. Sort the results by follower count in descending order.

question: Find communities where the average engagement duration of their members' interactions is greater than 120 seconds. Return the community name, description, and average engagement duration, sorted by average engagement duration in descending order.

question: Find users who are members of at least two communities with an activity level above 0.8 and have engaged with content items that are similar to at least five other content items. Return the user IDs, usernames, and the total number of similar content items they engaged with.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(c:Community) WHERE c.activityLevel > 0.8 RETURN u, COUNT(c) AS activeCommunities NEXT FILTER activeCommunities >= 2 MATCH (u)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)-[:SIMILAR_TO]->(similarCi:ContentItem) RETURN u.User_id, u.username, COUNT(similarCi) AS totalSimilarItems

question: Retrieve content items that have been engaged with by users who are interested in at least two interest tags from the 'Science' category and have also engaged with content from verified creators. Include the content item IDs, types, and the count of such qualified engagements.

question: Identify content items that have been engaged with by users interested in at least four different categories and were created by unverified creators. question: Find all communities where members have engaged with content items similar to at least two other content items with a similarity score above 0.95. Return the community name, description, and the average member count of such communities.

question: Retrieve a list of users who have engaged with content items of type 'video' more than 5 times and are interested in tags related to the category 'Technology'. Include the user ID, username, and the average sentiment of the engagement events associated with those videos.

question: Identify recommendation engines that have generated recommendations for users who are members of communities with an activity level above 0.8. Return the engine ID, algorithm type, and the number of distinct such active communities.

question: For each verified creator, find the average duration of engagement events for content items they have created. Only include creators whose content has received engagements with an average duration over 120 seconds. Return the creator's display name and the calculated average duration.

question: List the recommendation engines that have generated recommendations including at least one interest tag per category available in the system. Return the engine ID and the count of distinct categories covered.

question: Identify users who have engaged with content items similar to those created by verified creators and have shown interest in at least two interest tags with a popularity score greater than 8.0. Return the user ID and username.

question: Retrieve content items that were created by verified creators and have been engaged with by users who are interested in the 'Technology' category. Include the content item ID and the engagement timestamp.

question: Determine the recommendation engines that have generated recommendations for users who are interested in at least five different interest tags. Return the engine ID, algorithm type, and the count of distinct users recommended.

question: List the top 5 communities with the highest average sentiment scores from engagement events related to content items of type 'video'. Include the community name and the average sentiment score.
gql: MATCH (c:Community)<-[:MEMBER_OF]-(u:User)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem {type: 'video'})-[:RECORDED_AS]->(ee:EngagementEvent) RETURN c.name, AVG(ee.sentiment) AS avgSentiment ORDER BY avgSentiment DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find users who are interested in 'Technology' and have engaged with content items created by unverified creators. Return the usernames and the number of such engagements.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag{category:'Technology'}) RETURN u NEXT MATCH (u)-[e:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:CREATED]-(cr:Creator{verificationStatus:false}) RETURN u.username, COUNT(e) AS engagementCount

question: Find interest tags that are associated with content items created by unverified creators but have also been engaged with by users interested in 'Science' category tags. Return the interest tag name and the number of such associations.
gql: MATCH (it:InterestTag)<-[:INTERESTED_IN]-(u:User)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:CREATED]-(cr:Creator{verificationStatus:false}) RETURN it, ci NEXT MATCH (u)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(scienceIt:InterestTag{category:'Science'}) RETURN it.tagName, COUNT(ci) AS associationCount

question: Identify content items that were created by verified creators and have been engaged with by users who are part of at least two communities. For these content items, return the item ID, type, and the average sentiment of engagement events, but only include items where the average sentiment is greater than 0.6.
gql: MATCH (ci:ContentItem)<-[:CREATED]-(c:Creator{verificationStatus:true}) RETURN ci NEXT MATCH (ci)-[:RECORDED_AS]->(ee:EngagementEvent)<-[:RECORDED_AS]-(u:User)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(com:Community) RETURN ci, AVG(ee.sentiment) AS avgSentiment, COUNT(DISTINCT com) AS communityCount NEXT FILTER communityCount >= 2 AND avgSentiment > 0.6 RETURN ci.ContentItem_id, ci.type, avgSentiment

question: Find users who have shown interest in at least five different interest tags and have engaged with content items that are similar to other items with a similarity score greater than 0.8. Return the user ID, username, and the count of such similar content engagements.
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag) RETURN u, COUNT(DISTINCT it) AS interestCount NEXT FILTER interestCount >= 5 RETURN u NEXT MATCH (u)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(:ContentItem) WHERE s.similarityScore > 0.8 RETURN u.User_id, u.username, COUNT(s) AS similarEngagements

question: Identify users who have engaged with content items similar to those created by verified creators. Return the usernames of these users along with the count of distinct content items they engaged with, ordered by the count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (cr:Creator {verificationStatus: true})-[:CREATED]->(ci1:ContentItem)<-[:SIMILAR_TO]-(ci2:ContentItem)<-[e:ENGAGED_WITH]-(u:User) RETURN u.username, COUNT(DISTINCT ci2) AS distinctEngagedItems ORDER BY distinctEngagedItems DESC

question: Determine the interest tags associated with content items that have the highest average engagement duration. Consider only those tags linked to more than 3 content items. Return the tag names and the average engagement duration, sorted by the duration in descending order.
gql: MATCH (it:InterestTag)<-[:INTERESTED_IN]-(u:User)-[e:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem) RETURN it, ci, AVG(e.`duration`) AS avgDuration NEXT MATCH (it)<-[:INTERESTED_IN]-(:User)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci) RETURN it, avgDuration, COUNT(ci) AS itemCount NEXT FILTER itemCount > 3 RETURN it.tagName, avgDuration ORDER BY avgDuration DESC

question: Which recommendation engines have generated recommendations for users who have engaged with content items created by verified creators? Return the engine ID and the algorithm type.
gql: MATCH (re:RecommendationEngine)-[:GENERATED_BY]->(u:User)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:CREATED]-(cr:Creator) WHERE cr.verificationStatus = true RETURN DISTINCT re.RecommendationEngine_id, re.algorithmType

question: Find creators who have produced content items with an engagement metrics score higher than 0.8 and are verified. Additionally, retrieve the total count of such high-engagement content items per creator along with their display names.

question: Identify users who have engaged with at least five different content items that were created by verified creators and belong to the 'Technology' interest tag category. Return the user IDs and the average sentiment of their engagement events.

question: Retrieve recommendation engines that generated recommendations for users who are part of communities with an activity level greater than 0.9. Also include the version of these engines and the count of distinct users they recommended to.

question: Find content items that are similar to more than two other content items with a similarity score above 0.85 and have been engaged with by users having privacy settings set to 'public'. Return the content item IDs and the maximum duration of engagement events related to them.

question: List all recommendation engines that have generated recommendations for users who are members of at least two different communities. Also, include the algorithm type of the engine and the total number of distinct communities those users are part of.

question: Identify users who have engaged with content items created by verified creators only. Return the user IDs and the count of distinct content items they've engaged with.

question: Find users who have engaged with content items created by verified creators and are also members of communities with an activity level above 0.7. Return the user ID, username, and the number of such communities they are part of.

question: Find users who have shown interest in at least three different categories of interest tags and have engaged with content from unverified creators. Return the usernames and the number of distinct categories they are interested in.

question: List all content items created by verified creators that have been engaged with by users having a privacy setting of 'public'. Also, return the engagement type and timestamp for those engagements.

question: Retrieve all recommendation engines that have generated suggestions leading to content engagement with a duration longer than 120 seconds. Include the engine's ID, version, and the average engagement duration for its recommended content.

question: List users who have shown interest in at least five interest tags with a popularity score greater than 0.9, along with their usernames and the count of such high-popularity interests.

question: What are the top 10 most popular interest tags in the 'Technology' category, sorted by their popularity score in descending order?
gql: MATCH (it:InterestTag) WHERE it.category = 'Technology' RETURN it ORDER BY it.popularityScore DESC LIMIT 10

question: What are the top 20 content items of type 'article' with engagement metrics above 500, sorted by creation date in descending order?
gql: MATCH (c:ContentItem) WHERE c.type = 'article' AND c.engagementMetrics > '500' RETURN c ORDER BY c.creationDate DESC LIMIT 20

question: List all content items of type 'video' created by verified creators, sorted by their creation date in ascending order.
gql: MATCH (c:Creator {verificationStatus: true})-[:CREATED]->(ci:ContentItem {type: 'video'}) RETURN ci ORDER BY ci.creationDate ASC

question: Identify the shortest path connecting the interest tag 'IT000079' to any content item of type 'video'.
gql: MATCH (it:InterestTag{InterestTag_id:'IT000079'})-[]-{1,10}(ci:ContentItem{type:'video'}) RETURN it, ci LIMIT 1

question: How do interest tags relate to communities through users who are members of those communities and have specific privacy settings?
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(c:Community), (u)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(i:InterestTag) WHERE u.privacySettings IS NOT NULL RETURN u, c, i

question: Which content items of type 'article' have been engaged with by users who are also members of the community named 'Travel military total raise dark'?
gql: MATCH (c:Community {name: 'Travel military total raise dark'})-[:MEMBER_OF]-(u:User)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]-(ci:ContentItem {type: 'article'}) RETURN ci

question: Find all creators who have created content items that were recommended by a recommendation engine to users interested in the 'Technology' category.
gql: MATCH (c:Creator)-[:CREATED]->(ci:ContentItem)<-[:GENERATED_BY]-(re:RecommendationEngine)-[:GENERATED_BY]->(u:User)-[i:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag) WHERE it.category = 'Technology' RETURN DISTINCT c

question: Which users have engaged with content items that are similar to the content item with ID 'CI000427'?
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)-[:SIMILAR_TO]->(ci2:ContentItem {ContentItem_id: 'CI000427'}) RETURN DISTINCT u

question: Show content items whose engagement metrics are higher than the engagement metrics of the content item with ContentItem_id 'CI000427'.
gql: MATCH (ci:ContentItem{ContentItem_id:'CI000427'}) RETURN ci.engagementMetrics AS targetEngagement NEXT MATCH (c:ContentItem) WHERE c.engagementMetrics > targetEngagement RETURN c

question: Retrieve all paths between the engagement event 'EE000394' and its associated user.
gql: MATCH (ee:EngagementEvent {EngagementEvent_id: 'EE000394'})<-[:RECORDED_AS]-(u:User) RETURN ee, u

question: What interest tags are associated with the user having User_id 'U000160'?
gql: MATCH (u:User {User_id: 'U000160'})-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(i:InterestTag) RETURN i.tagName

question: Which users are members of the community named 'Travel military total raise dark'?
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(c:Community) WHERE c.name = 'Travel military total raise dark' RETURN u

question: Which content items have been created by the creator with Creator_id 'CR000015'?
gql: MATCH (c:Creator {Creator_id: 'CR000015'})-[:CREATED]->(ci:ContentItem) RETURN ci

question: Which communities has the user with username 'bparker' joined?
gql: MATCH (u:User {username: 'bparker'})-[:MEMBER_OF]->(c:Community) RETURN c

question: What are the recommendation engines associated with the user 'U000476'?
gql: MATCH (re:RecommendationEngine)-[:GENERATED_BY]->(u:User) WHERE u.User_id = 'U000476' RETURN re

question: List all communities that have members who are interested in 'Sports' related interest tags and have an activity level above 0.5.
gql: MATCH (c:Community) WHERE c.activityLevel > 0.5 RETURN c NEXT MATCH (c)<-[:MEMBER_OF]-(u:User)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(i:InterestTag) WHERE i.category = 'Sports' RETURN DISTINCT c

question: What is the average content quality score of all creators in the database?
gql: MATCH (c:Creator) RETURN avg(c.contentQualityScore) AS averageContentQualityScore

question: Find users who share common interest tags with the user 'U000160' and have also engaged with content items similar to 'CI000427'.
gql: MATCH (u:User {User_id: 'U000160'})-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(tag:InterestTag)<-[:INTERESTED_IN]-(otherUser:User), (u)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(item:ContentItem)-[:SIMILAR_TO]->(similarItem:ContentItem)<-[:ENGAGED_WITH]-(otherUser) RETURN DISTINCT otherUser

question: Identify users whose last active date is more recent than the last active date of the user with User_id 'U000160'.
gql: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.User_id = 'U000160' RETURN u.lastActive AS targetLastActive NEXT MATCH (v:User) WHERE v.lastActive > targetLastActive RETURN v

question: How many interest tags are associated with each user?
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[i:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag) RETURN u.User_id, count(it) AS interestTagCount

question: What is the average sentiment score of all engagement events?
gql: MATCH (e:EngagementEvent) RETURN avg(e.sentiment) AS averageSentimentScore

question: How many users have engaged with content items more than 5 times?
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[e:ENGAGED_WITH]->(c:ContentItem) RETURN u, count(e) AS engagementCount NEXT FILTER engagementCount > 5 RETURN count(u) AS userCount

question: How many recommendation engines are associated with each user?
gql: MATCH (re:RecommendationEngine)-[:GENERATED_BY]->(u:User) RETURN u.User_id AS userId, count(re) AS recommendationEngineCount

question: How many content items of each type have been created by unverified creators?
gql: MATCH (c:Creator {verificationStatus: false})-[:CREATED]->(ci:ContentItem) RETURN ci.type, count(ci) AS contentCount

question: Are there any interest tags in the 'Technology' category with a popularity score greater than 70?
gql: MATCH (i:InterestTag) WHERE i.category = 'Technology' AND i.popularityScore > 70 RETURN i

question: Find all content items that are similar to the content item with ID 'CI000427' and list the users who engaged with those similar items.
gql: MATCH (ci:ContentItem {ContentItem_id: 'CI000427'})-[:SIMILAR_TO]-(similarCi:ContentItem)<-[:ENGAGED_WITH]-(u:User) RETURN DISTINCT ci.ContentItem_id AS originalContentId, similarCi.ContentItem_id AS similarContentId, u.User_id AS userId

question: Which users are interested in the same interest tags as the user with User_id 'U000160'?
gql: MATCH (u:User {User_id: 'U000160'})-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(tag:InterestTag)<-[:INTERESTED_IN]-(otherUsers:User) RETURN DISTINCT otherUsers

question: Which content items have been engaged with by users who are members of the community named 'Travel military total raise dark'?
gql: MATCH (c:Community {name: 'Travel military total raise dark'})<-[:MEMBER_OF]-(u:User)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem) RETURN DISTINCT ci

question: Which users share common interest tags with the user 'U000160' and have also engaged with content items similar to 'CI000427'?
gql: MATCH (u1:User {User_id: 'U000160'})-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(tag:InterestTag)<-[:INTERESTED_IN]-(u2:User)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)-[:SIMILAR_TO]->(:ContentItem {ContentItem_id: 'CI000427'}) RETURN DISTINCT u2.User_id

question: Find all communities with an activity level higher than the community named 'Travel military total raise dark'.
gql: MATCH (c:Community) WHERE c.name = 'Travel military total raise dark' RETURN c NEXT MATCH (c2:Community) WHERE c2.activityLevel > c RETURN c2

question: Retrieve all content items with a creation date more recent than the content item authored by creator 'CR000011'.
gql: MATCH (c:ContentItem{authorId:'CR000011'}) RETURN c.creationDate AS referenceDate NEXT MATCH (ci:ContentItem) WHERE ci.creationDate > referenceDate RETURN ci

question: Which users have a registration date earlier than the user with username 'bparker'?
gql: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.username = 'bparker' RETURN u.registrationDate AS targetDate NEXT MATCH (v:User) WHERE v.registrationDate < targetDate RETURN v.User_id

question: Which content items are similar to the content item with ID 'CI000427' and have been engaged with by the same users?
gql: MATCH (ci1:ContentItem{ContentItem_id:'CI000427'})-[:SIMILAR_TO]-(ci2:ContentItem) RETURN ci2 NEXT MATCH (ci2)<-[:ENGAGED_WITH]-(u:User)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci1) RETURN DISTINCT ci2

question: Which users have engaged with content items that are similar to the content item with ID 'CI000427' and are also interested in the same interest tags as the user with User_id 'U000160'?
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:ENGAGED_WITH]->(ci:ContentItem)-[:SIMILAR_TO]->(:ContentItem{ContentItem_id:'CI000427'}) RETURN u NEXT MATCH (u)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(it:InterestTag)<-[:INTERESTED_IN]-(:User{User_id:'U000160'}) RETURN DISTINCT u

question: Are there any interest tags in the 'Sports' category with a popularity score greater than 80?
gql: MATCH (i:InterestTag) WHERE i.category = 'Sports' AND i.popularityScore > 80 RETURN i

question: Are there any engagement events of type 'comment' with a sentiment score greater than 0.8?
gql: MATCH (ee:EngagementEvent) WHERE ee.engagementType = 'comment' AND ee.sentiment > 0.8 RETURN ee

question: Is there any creator with a verification status of true and a follower count exceeding 50000?
gql: MATCH (c:Creator) WHERE c.verificationStatus = true AND c.followerCount > 50000 RETURN c

question: What communities do users who are interested in the 'Technology' category also commonly join?
gql: MATCH (u:User)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(i:InterestTag {category: 'Technology'}), (u)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(c:Community) RETURN c.name, count(*) AS frequency ORDER BY frequency DESC

question: Find all EngagementEvent nodes connected to ContentItem nodes via the RECORDED_AS relationship where the engagement type is 'comment'.
gql: MATCH (n1:ContentItem)-[e:RECORDED_AS]->(n2:EngagementEvent) WHERE n2.engagementType = "comment" RETURN e, n2 LIMIT 10

question: Find all two-hop paths where the starting ContentItem has ID 'CI000000' and the ending EngagementEvent has engagementType 'comment', returning at most 1 path.
gql: MATCH p = (n1:ContentItem)-[e1]-(x)-[e2]-(n2:EngagementEvent) WHERE n1.ContentItem_id = "CI000000" AND n2.engagementType = "comment" RETURN p LIMIT 1

question: Find two-hop and three-hop paths from ContentItem with ID 'CI000000' to other EngagementEvents excluding those with sentiment less than 0, returning at most 5 paths for each type.
gql: MATCH p = (n1:ContentItem)-[e1]-(x)-[e2]-(n2:EngagementEvent) WHERE n1.ContentItem_id = "CI000000" AND n2.sentiment >= 0 RETURN p LIMIT 5 UNION ALL MATCH p = (n1:ContentItem)-[e1]-(x)-[e2]-(y)-[e3]-(n2:EngagementEvent) WHERE n1.ContentItem_id = "CI000000" AND n2.sentiment >= 0 RETURN p LIMIT 5

question: Find up to 1 two-hop path where the starting ContentItem has ID 'CI000000' and the ending EngagementEvent has a sentiment different from 0.21.
gql: MATCH p = (n1:ContentItem)-[e1]-(x)-[e2]-(n2:EngagementEvent) WHERE n1.ContentItem_id = "CI000000" AND n2.sentiment <> 0.21 RETURN p LIMIT 1

question: Find all EngagementEvent nodes recorded as comments with positive sentiment (> 0.2) for ContentItem nodes of type 'video'.
gql: MATCH (n1:ContentItem)-[e:RECORDED_AS]->(n2:EngagementEvent) WHERE n1.type = "video" AND n2.engagementType = "comment" AND n2.sentiment > 0.2 RETURN n1, e, n2 LIMIT 10

question: Return the first ContentItem node where engagementMetrics is null.
gql: MATCH (n:ContentItem) WHERE n.engagementMetrics IS NULL RETURN n LIMIT 1

question: Find ContentItems recorded as EngagementEvents with sentiment greater than 0.2, return the ContentItem, count of such events, and the EngagementEvent, ordered by count descending, skipping 1, and limiting to 5 results.
gql: MATCH (n2:EngagementEvent)<-[e1:RECORDED_AS]-(n1:ContentItem) WHERE n2.sentiment > 0.2 RETURN n1, COUNT(e1) as cnte1, n2 ORDER BY cnte1 DESC SKIP 1 LIMIT 5

question: Count distinct EngagementEvents that are recorded as outcomes of ContentItems authored by 'CR000001'.
gql: MATCH (n1:ContentItem)-[:RECORDED_AS]->(n2:EngagementEvent) WHERE n1.authorId = "CR000001" RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT n2) as count_alias

question: Find two-hop paths where the starting ContentItem has ID 'CI000000' and the ending EngagementEvent has engagementType not equal to 'comment', returning only one such path.
gql: MATCH p = (n1:ContentItem)-[e1]-(x)-[e2]-(n2:EngagementEvent) WHERE n1.ContentItem_id = "CI000000" AND n2.engagementType <> "comment" RETURN p LIMIT 1

question: Count how many unique EngagementEvents have a sentiment score greater than 0.2 for ContentItem 'CI000000'.
gql: MATCH (n1:ContentItem)-[]->(n2:EngagementEvent) WHERE n1.ContentItem_id = "CI000000" AND n2.sentiment > 0.2 RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT n2) as count_alias

question: Find all paths where a ContentItem is connected to another ContentItem through shared EngagementEvents, ensuring the first ContentItem has ID 'CI000000' and the second does not.
gql: MATCH p = (n1:ContentItem)-[e1]-(x:EngagementEvent)-[e2]-(n2:ContentItem) WHERE n1.ContentItem_id = "CI000000" AND n2.ContentItem_id <> "CI000000" RETURN p LIMIT 5 UNION ALL MATCH p = (n1:ContentItem)-[e1]-(x:EngagementEvent)-[e2]-(y)-[e3]-(n2:ContentItem) WHERE n1.ContentItem_id = "CI000000" AND n2.ContentItem_id <> "CI000000" RETURN p LIMIT 5

question: Find all ContentItems recorded as EngagementEvents with a sentiment greater than 0.2, limited to 5 results.
gql: MATCH (n1:ContentItem)-[e:RECORDED_AS]->(n2:EngagementEvent) WHERE n2.sentiment > 0.2 RETURN n1, n2 LIMIT 5

question: Retrieve ContentItems authored by CR000001 along with their associated EngagementEvents and the relationship details.
gql: MATCH (nodes_1:ContentItem) WHERE nodes_1.authorId = "CR000001" RETURN nodes_1 NEXT MATCH (nodes_1)-[edges_1:RECORDED_AS]->(nodes_2:EngagementEvent) RETURN nodes_2, nodes_1, edges_1 LIMIT 10

question: Find all EngagementEvents recorded as comments for ContentItem with ID 'CI000000', and return the EngagementEvent nodes along with their relationship to the ContentItem.
gql: MATCH (n1:ContentItem)-[e:RECORDED_AS]->(n2:EngagementEvent) WHERE n1.ContentItem_id = "CI000000" AND n2.engagementType = "comment" RETURN n1, e, n2 LIMIT 10

question: Which ContentItems have the highest number of associated EngagementEvents? Return the ContentItem, count of events, and the EngagementEvent nodes, ordered by count descending, skipping the top result and limiting to 5.
gql: MATCH (n2:EngagementEvent)<-[e1:RECORDED_AS]-(n1:ContentItem) RETURN n1, COUNT(e1) as cnte1, n2 ORDER BY cnte1 DESC SKIP 1 LIMIT 5

question: Find variable-length paths between ContentItem and EngagementEvent up to 3 hops for the content authored by 'CR000001'.
gql: MATCH (n1:ContentItem)-[e]-{1,3}(n2:EngagementEvent) WHERE n1.authorId = "CR000001" RETURN n1, n2 LIMIT 5

question: Find all ContentItem nodes with type 'video' and return them, limited to 10 results.
gql: MATCH (n:ContentItem) WHERE n.type = "video" RETURN n LIMIT 10

question: Count distinct EngagementEvent nodes connected from ContentItem where authorId is 'CR000001'.
gql: MATCH (n1:ContentItem)-[]->(n2:EngagementEvent) WHERE n1.authorId = "CR000001" RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT n2) as count_alias

question: Find all EngagementEvents linked to ContentItem with ID 'CI000000', including their sentiment and engagement type.
gql: MATCH (a:ContentItem)-[:RECORDED_AS]->(b:EngagementEvent) WHERE a.ContentItem_id = "CI000000" RETURN DISTINCT b.sentiment, b.engagementType LIMIT 10

question: Count how many distinct EngagementEvents have a sentiment greater than 0.2, related to any ContentItem.
gql: MATCH (n1:ContentItem)-[]->(n2:EngagementEvent) WHERE n2.sentiment > 0.2 RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT n2) AS count_alias

question: Retrieve all paths of length 1 to 3 connecting ContentItem nodes to EngagementEvent nodes.
gql: MATCH (n1:ContentItem)-[e]-{1,3}(n2:EngagementEvent) RETURN n1, n2 LIMIT 5

question: Locate the EngagementEvent with engagementType 'comment' and return only this specific event's data, capped at one record.
gql: MATCH (n:EngagementEvent) WHERE n.engagementType = "comment" RETURN n LIMIT 1

question: Find a two-hop path where the starting ContentItem has ID 'CI000000' and the ending EngagementEvent does not have engagementType 'like', returning only one such path.
gql: MATCH p = (n1:ContentItem)-[e1]-(x)-[e2]-(n2:EngagementEvent) WHERE n1.ContentItem_id = "CI000000" AND n2.engagementType <> "like" RETURN p LIMIT 1
